nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) _balances holding token balances of every account.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) _allowed holding spend allowances.
Private uint256 _totalSupply tracking the total number of minted tokens.
Public constant string name = 'Remitano Token'.
Public constant string symbol = 'RET'.
Public constant uint8 decimals = 18.
Public constant uint256 INITIAL_SUPPLY = 1000000 * 10**decimals, the total minted at construction.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for balance and allowance lookups and as mint recipient.
totalSupply() public view returning _totalSupply.
balanceOf(address owner) public view returning _balances[owner].
allowance(address owner, address spender) public view returning _allowed[owner][spender].
transfer(address to, uint256 value) public: debits msg.sender and credits to using SafeMath sub/add, emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint256 value) public: sets _allowed[msg.sender][spender] = value, emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) public: moves balances and decrements allowance of msg.sender.
increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public: adds addedValue to the caller's allowance.
decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) public: subtracts subtractedValue from the caller's allowance.
_mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal: increases _totalSupply and _balances[account], emits Transfer from address(0).
RemiToken constructor: mints INITIAL_SUPPLY to msg.sender via _mint.
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure: returns a*b, reverts on overflow.
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure: requires b > 0, returns a/b.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure: requires b <= a, returns a-b.
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure: returns a+b, reverts on overflow.
SafeMath.mod(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure: requires b != 0, returns a % b.
Multiplication 'uint256 c = a * b;' guarded by require(c / a == b) in SafeMath.mul.
Division 'uint256 c = a / b;' guarded by require(b > 0) in SafeMath.div.
Subtraction 'uint256 c = a - b;' guarded by require(b <= a) in SafeMath.sub.
Addition 'uint256 c = a + b;' guarded by require(c >= a) in SafeMath.add.
Modulo 'a % b' guarded by require(b != 0) in SafeMath.mod.
Balance mutation in transfer: _balances[msg.sender].sub(value) and _balances[to].add(value).
Allowance mutation in approve: _allowed[msg.sender][spender] = value.
Balance and allowance mutations in transferFrom: _balances[from], _balances[to], _allowed[from][msg.sender].
Supply and balance mutation in _mint: _totalSupply.add(amount) and _balances[account].add(amount).
Parameter 'address to' of ERC20.transfer, the recipient of the tokens.
Parameter 'uint256 value' of ERC20.transfer, the amount to move.
Parameter 'address spender' of ERC20.approve, the address receiving the allowance.
Parameter 'uint256 value' of ERC20.approve, the allowance amount.
Parameter 'address from' of ERC20.transferFrom, the debited account.
Parameter 'address to' of ERC20.transferFrom, the credited account.
Parameter 'uint256 value' of ERC20.transferFrom, the amount to move.
Parameter 'address spender' of ERC20.increaseAllowance.
Parameter 'uint256 addedValue' of ERC20.increaseAllowance, added to the allowance.
Parameter 'address spender' of ERC20.decreaseAllowance.
Parameter 'uint256 subtractedValue' of ERC20.decreaseAllowance, removed from the allowance.
Parameter 'address account' of ERC20._mint, the recipient of newly created tokens.
Parameter 'uint256 amount' of ERC20._mint, the quantity created.
Parameter 'uint256 a' of SafeMath.mul, multiplicand.
Parameter 'uint256 b' of SafeMath.mul, multiplier.
Parameter 'uint256 a' of SafeMath.div, dividend.
Parameter 'uint256 b' of SafeMath.div, divisor.
Parameter 'uint256 a' of SafeMath.sub, minuend.
Parameter 'uint256 b' of SafeMath.sub, subtrahend.
Parameter 'uint256 a' of SafeMath.add, first addend.
Parameter 'uint256 b' of SafeMath.add, second addend.
Parameter 'uint256 a' of SafeMath.mod, dividend.
Parameter 'uint256 b' of SafeMath.mod, divisor.
Parameter 'address owner' of ERC20.balanceOf, the queried account.
Parameter 'address owner' of ERC20.allowance, the funds owner.
Parameter 'address spender' of ERC20.allowance, the spender address.
Local 'uint256 c' in SafeMath.mul holding the product a * b.
Local 'uint256 c' in SafeMath.div holding the quotient a / b.
Local 'uint256 c' in SafeMath.sub holding the difference a - b.
Local 'uint256 c' in SafeMath.add holding the sum a + b.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the debited account and identity in transfer.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written in approve.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner updated in increaseAllowance.
msg.sender is the allowance owner updated in decreaseAllowance.
msg.sender receives INITIAL_SUPPLY in the RemiToken constructor.
Caller identity controls which balance is debited in transfer.
Caller identity controls whose allowance mapping slot is written in approve.
Caller identity gates the allowance/balance writes in transferFrom.
Caller identity determines the mint recipient during construction.
transfer performs the balance writes on _balances.
approve performs the allowance write on _allowed.
transferFrom performs the balance and allowance writes.
_mint performs the supply and balance writes.
SafeMath.mul executes the guarded multiplication a * b.
SafeMath.div executes the guarded division a / b.
SafeMath.sub executes the guarded subtraction a - b.
SafeMath.add executes the guarded addition a + b.
SafeMath.mod executes the guarded modulo a % b.
transfer calls SafeMath.sub to debit the sender balance safely.
transfer calls SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance safely.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.sub for balances and allowance.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.add to credit the recipient.
increaseAllowance calls SafeMath.add on the allowance.
decreaseAllowance calls SafeMath.sub on the allowance.
_mint calls SafeMath.add for supply and balance updates.
The constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply.
decimals participates in the INITIAL_SUPPLY exponentiation.
INITIAL_SUPPLY is the amount minted by the constructor.
balanceOf reads _balances[owner].
transfer reads and writes _balances for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes _balances for from and to.
_mint credits _balances[account].
allowance reads _allowed[owner][spender].
approve writes _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom reads and decreases _allowed[from][msg.sender].
increaseAllowance adds to _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
decreaseAllowance subtracts from _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
totalSupply returns _totalSupply.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
